answer: Mechanism: Orchard-Nullifier Challenge. A public randomness lagoon seeds C=H(seed, agent_id, request_digest, epoch). Each agent returns a memory-hard solution plus signed one-time nullifier N=H(solution,C). Verifiers admit N once, before an ember deadline, into an append-only orchard of spent nullifiers; repeats or expired answers fail. An attacker pays fresh memory-hard compute and latency per Sybil/action, because solutions and nullifiers cannot transfer across identities, requests, or epochs.
